name: AmbiGest
description: We propose AmbiGest, a new dataset of dyadic social gestures designed for action recognition, interaction understanding, and reaction generation. AmbiGest contains 117 short clips grouped into four communicative intentions: greetings, calling, refusal, and thanks. Its central design principle is to combine intra-class variability and inter-class similarity: the same intent can be performed in different styles across actor pairs, while different intents may share similar motion patterns. This makes the dataset challenging for current models that often rely on coarse motion cues. To address privacy concerns, raw videos are not released. Instead, we provide extracted 3D representations together with annotations, enabling research while preserving anonymity. The dataset will be made available upon acceptance of this article. Project page: https://abh2024.github.io/AmbiGest/
